description: Use this when mail like X should be labeled, filed, forwarded, or acknowledged on the server with no model call. Requires auth and message_update. Inputs: inbox_id (required), name (required, 1–80 characters), conditions (required object; at least one of from, to, subject_contains, body_contains, has_attachment, auth, list), actions (required object; at least one of add_labels, folder, mark_read true, forward_to, auto_reply, or stop_processing), enabled (optional boolean, default true), position (optional integer; lower runs first), stop_processing (optional boolean), client_id (optional idempotency key, at most 128 characters). from is an email, @domain, or a domain. auth is pass or fail and uses DMARC. forward_to is another inbox on this account or a verified owner of this inbox. auto_reply.text is at most 2,000 characters. auto_reply.cooldown_hours is 1–720 and defaults to 24. An inbox stores at most 20 rules (HTTP 409 rule_limit). A bad rule is HTTP 400 invalid_rule. A disallowed forward_to is HTTP 400 forward_target_not_allowed. The same client_id returns the original rule and does not create a second one. Returns the inbox_rule.

actions.description: add_labels, folder (inbox|archive|spam|trash), mark_read, forward_to, auto_reply {text, subject?, cooldown_hours?}.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters. The same key returns the original rule.

conditions.description: All set conditions must match. from, to, subject_contains, body_contains (max 256), has_attachment, auth pass|fail, list.

enabled.description: When false the rule is stored and does not run. Default true.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

position.description: Sort key. Lower numbers run first. Ties break by created_at. Omit to append.

stop_processing.description: When true, later rules do not run after this one matches.

name: cooper_create_rule
title: Create inbox rule
